Context: 6. Proceedings after Retirement

3. If in any departmental or judicial proceedings initiated prior to or after retirement, the pensioner is found guilty of grave misconduct or negligence during the period of his service including service rendered on re-employment after retirement, whole or part of any pecuniary loss caused to the Government may be recovered from the pension or gratuity. The power to issue orders will rest with the President. - Rule 8.
